steps.summary_text: GDACS Category 1 tracking off Odisha coast. Cloud bands increasing. River discharge baseline 140 m3/s.

emergency_calls.patient_condition: Severe Asthma attack aggravated by humidity
Minor blunt trauma from pre-storm securing

steps.summary_text: Cyclone cone narrows directly onto Puri coastline. GloFAS discharge jumps to 490 m3/s. Storm surge watch initiated.

emergency_calls.patient_condition: Fractured femur from collapsed tin roof

steps.time_label: T-6 Hours: Flood Warning & Bridge Overtopping
steps.summary_text: Torrential rain and GloFAS river surge breach low banks. Kushabhadra River Bridge and Bhargavi River Low Bridge failure probability exceeds 0.85.

edge_marine_drive_kushabhadra_bridge.closure_reason: Kushabhadra River overtopped bridge deck by 0.7m.

edge_nh316_bhargavi_bridge.closure_reason: Bhargavi River flood crest submerged approach culverts.

emergency_calls.patient_condition: Severe polytrauma from coastal wall collapse
Cardiac arrest with CPR in progress

steps.time_label: Landfall: Eye Crosses Coastline (Power & Comms Down)
steps.summary_text: Extremely Severe Cyclone makes landfall near Puri. Coastal Infectious Disease Hospital loses power and comms; ICU derated to 0. Coastal roads flooded.

edge_marine_drive_kushabhadra_bridge.closure_reason: Severe inundation on bridge deck (1.4m depth).

edge_nh316_bhargavi_bridge.closure_reason: Bhargavi bridge completely impassable due to raging river flow.

edge_coastal_beach_road.closure_reason: Storm surge sea water inundation along Puri beach boulevard.

hosp_puri_coastal_id.status_reason: Grid power loss + flooded generator + comms drop. ICU offline.

emergency_calls.patient_condition: Critical crushed chest injury requiring emergency thoracic surgery & ICU
Severe acute respiratory failure requiring ICU mechanical ventilation
Deep lacerations with severe arterial bleeding

steps.time_label: T+6 Hours Post-Landfall: Highway Debris Blockage
steps.summary_text: Cyclone moves inland. Large uprooted banyan trees and high-tension electrical cables block NH-316 between Satyabadi and Pipili.

edge_marine_drive_kushabhadra_bridge.closure_reason: Flooding receding slowly; structural integrity check pending.

edge_nh316_bhargavi_bridge.closure_reason: River discharge still above critical flood stage.

edge_coastal_beach_road.closure_reason: Heavy sand dunes and sea debris blocking boulevard.

edge_nh316_satyabadi_pipili.closure_reason: Uprooted giant trees and collapsed 33kV high-voltage lines across highway.

hosp_puri_coastal_id.status_reason: Grid power loss + flooded generator + comms drop. ICU offline.

emergency_calls.patient_condition: Traumatic head injury from flying structural debris
